value.rationale: This is a complete, natural first-order rank-four theory classification of the diameter-two Moore family, a distinguished extremal graph family with an unresolved degree-57 existence problem. The nontrivial finding is a sharp extension-support stabilization that places every possible 3250-vertex exceptional graph in the 50-vertex Hoffman–Singleton theory and identifies exact lower-degree separators. The representative bound 50 is optimal within the family; its determination and explicit Ehrenfeucht strategy provide reusable finite-model-theoretic insight.
